limitations: No Web Browsing Tooling: The existing GeminiProvider (backend/ai/gemini_provider.py) invokes client.models.generate_content without Google Search grounding or web retrieval tools.
LLM Architecture Constraint: Pure LLM text generation cannot make autonomous outbound HTTP requests to crawl third-party websites without an explicit tool/crawler pipeline.

Dynamic Client-Side SPA: iGOT Karmayogi (https://www.igotkarmayogi.gov.in/) is an Angular Single Page Application; its course catalogue is loaded asynchronously via Sunbird client-side JavaScript APIs rather than pre-rendered HTML.
Authentication & Access Controls: Comprehensive course enrollment and internal competency frameworks on iGOT are protected by Parichay SSO / government portal authentication.
Current Configuration: GEMINI_API_KEY is not set in the default environment, and default AI_PROVIDER in SmartLearn is configured for offline mock/openrouter workflows.
recommendation: Do NOT rely on direct Gemini prompt-based crawling for iGOT catalogue synchronization. Instead, implement a dedicated backend Ingestion Service / REST API client (or periodic Sunbird search API scraper) that fetches public catalogue JSON, stores/caches the metadata locally, and provides grounded course documents to Gemini for intelligent semantic matching and gap-based recommendations.
